title: 第25章 鹰国机甲展科技威慑第26章 欧国王子初见柳若兮
lines: 第25章鹰国机甲展，科技威慑
黑日国使者挑衅失败的第二天，鹰国使团便在京城的广场上举办了一场盛大的机甲展，向龙国展示他们最先进的科技成果。消息一出，整个京城都轰动了，百姓们纷纷涌向广场，想要亲眼见识一下传说中的机甲。七人小队也跟着人群，来到了广场上。
广场中央，停放着三辆巨大的重型机甲。机甲通体由黑色的金属制成，高达十丈，浑身布满了炮管和导弹发射架，在阳光的照射下，闪烁着冰冷的金属光泽，如同三头沉睡的钢铁巨兽，散发着令人窒息的压迫感。
广场周围，站满了荷枪实弹的鹰国士兵，他们神情严肃，警惕地看着周围的人群，不许任何人靠近机甲。
鹰国使者站在高台上，拿着扩音器，得意洋洋地介绍着这些机甲。“各位，这就是我们鹰国最新研制的‘毁灭者’重型机甲，每台机甲重达百吨，配备了十二门激光炮和二十四枚洲际导弹，威力足以摧毁一座城池，就算是筑基期的修士，在它面前也不堪一击。”
台下的百姓们顿时发出一阵惊叹声，纷纷议论起来。“我的天，这机甲也太厉害了吧。”“这么大的家伙，一炮下去，谁能挡得住啊。”“难怪鹰国这么嚣张，原来有这么厉害的武器。”
龙国的大臣们也都脸色凝重，他们原本以为龙国的武道天下无敌，可现在看到鹰国的机甲，才知道自己有多么的井底之蛙。丞相更是脸色苍白，心中暗自庆幸，幸好自己主张和谈，要是真的和鹰国打起来，龙国恐怕真的不是对手。
鹰国使者看着众人震惊的表情，脸上的得意之色更浓了。他挥了挥手，一个士兵立刻按下了手中的遥控器。其中一台机甲缓缓地站了起来，发出了“轰隆隆”的巨响，地面都随之微微颤抖。
机甲抬起手臂，对准了远处的一座小山。“轰”的一声，一枚导弹呼啸而出，拖着长长的尾焰击中了小山。瞬间，火光冲天，浓烟滚滚，整座小山都被夷为了平地。
台下的百姓们吓得尖叫起来，纷纷向后退去。龙国的大臣们更是面如死灰，浑身颤抖。他们终于明白，在绝对的科技力量面前，个人的武道修为，是多么的渺小。
“怎么样，各位，我们鹰国的机甲，还入得了各位的眼吧。”鹰国使者笑着说道，语气中充满了炫耀。“只要龙国愿意和我们合作，我们可以向龙国出售这些机甲，帮助龙国提升国防力量。当然，前提是，龙国要答应我们的一些条件。”
第25章鹰国机甲展，科技威慑
龙行步站在高台上，看着被夷为平地的小山，眼神中充满了震撼。他原本以为五国只是虚张声势，可现在才知道，他们真的有能力覆灭龙国。他的心里，更加坚定了和谈的想法。
“好，好，贵国的科技果然名不虚传。”龙行步连忙说道。“合作的事情，我们可以慢慢谈，只要能实现和平，一切都好商量。”
鹰国使者闻言，脸上露出了满意的笑容。他知道，龙行步已经被机甲的威力震慑住了，和谈的事情，已经十拿九稳了。
七人小队站在人群中，脸色都十分难看。“太嚣张了，不就是几个破铁疙瘩吗，有什么了不起的。”悟空愤愤不平地说道。“要是让我靠近它，我一棒子就能把它砸烂。”
“没那么简单。”杨戬摇了摇头。“这些机甲的防御很强，而且火力凶猛，我们根本靠近不了，就算是筑基期的修士，也很难抵挡导弹的攻击。”
庄周看着远处的机甲残骸，眼神中充满了恐惧。他想起了噩梦中的场景，五国联军就是驾驶着这些机甲，对龙国展开了疯狂的屠杀，无数的龙国百姓死在了机甲的炮火之下，血流成河，尸横遍野。
“原来，这就是他们的底气。”庄周喃喃自语道。“难怪他们敢如此明目张胆地策划灭国阴谋，有了这些机甲，他们根本不把龙国的武道放在眼里。”
小蝶紧紧地抓着庄周的手，身体微微颤抖。“庄周，这些铁疙瘩好可怕，我们会不会有事啊。”
庄周深吸一口气，压下心中的恐惧，柔声安慰道。“别怕，不会有事的，我们一定会想到办法的。”
可他的心里，却一片冰凉。他知道，仅凭七人小队的力量，根本无法对抗五国的科技大军，想要阻止这场灾难，难如登天。
机甲展结束后，主和派的声音更加高涨了。大臣们纷纷上书龙行步，请求尽快与五国签订和平盟约，不要再挑起战争。龙行步也下定决心，无论五国提出什么条件，他都要答应，只要能换来和平。
袁天罡得知消息后，心急如焚，再次求见龙行步，可依旧被拒之门外。他站在皇宫门口，望着天空，老泪纵横。“天要亡我龙国啊，天要亡我龙国啊。”

Chapter 25 Eagle Country Mecha Exhibition, Technological Deterrence
The day after the Black Sun envoy's provocation failed, the Eagle Kingdom's envoy held a grand mecha exhibition in the square of the capital to showcase their most advanced technological achievements to the Dragon Kingdom. As soon as the news came out, the entire capital was in a sensation, and people flocked to the square one after another, wanting to see the legendary mecha with their own eyes. The seven-member team also followed the crowd and came to the square.
In the center of the square, there are three huge heavy mechas parked. The mecha was made of black metal and was ten feet high. It was covered with gun barrels and missile launchers. Under the sunlight, it shone with a cold metallic luster, like three sleeping steel behemoths, exuding a suffocating sense of oppression.
Around the square were standing soldiers from the Eagle Nation with loaded weapons and ammunition. They looked seriously and watched the crowds around them vigilantly, not allowing anyone to get close to the mecha.
The envoy from the Eagle Kingdom stood on a high platform, holding a loudspeaker, and proudly introduced these mechas. "Everyone, this is the 'Destroyer' heavy mecha newly developed by our Eagle Kingdom. Each mecha weighs a hundred tons and is equipped with twelve laser cannons and twenty-four intercontinental missiles. It is powerful enough to destroy a city. Even monks in the foundation building stage are vulnerable to it."
The people in the audience suddenly let out a burst of exclamation and started talking one after another. "Oh my god, this mecha is so powerful." "Who can stop such a big guy with one shot?" "No wonder Yingguo is so arrogant, it turns out there are such powerful weapons."
The ministers of the Dragon Kingdom also had serious expressions on their faces. They originally thought that the martial arts of the Dragon Kingdom were invincible, but now they saw the mechas of the Eagle Kingdom and realized how weak they were. The prime minister's face was even more pale, and he was secretly glad in his heart. Fortunately, he advocated peace talks. If he really fought with the Eagle Kingdom, the Dragon Kingdom might not be his opponent.
The envoy from the Eagle Kingdom looked at the shocked expressions of everyone, and the look of pride on his face became even stronger. He waved his hand, and a soldier immediately pressed the remote control in his hand. One of the mechas slowly stood up and made a loud "rumbling" sound, causing the ground to tremble slightly.
The mecha raised its arm and aimed at a hill in the distance. With a "boom", a missile roared out and hit the hill with a long tail flame. In an instant, flames shot into the sky, thick smoke billowed, and the entire hill was razed to the ground.
The people in the audience screamed in fear and backed away. The ministers of the Dragon Kingdom were even more ashen-faced and trembling all over. They finally understood how insignificant individual martial arts cultivation was in the face of the absolute power of technology.
"How about it, everyone, our Eagle Kingdom's mechas are worthy of your attention." The Eagle Kingdom's envoy said with a smile, his tone full of showing off. "As long as the Dragon Kingdom is willing to cooperate with us, we can sell these mechas to the Dragon Kingdom and help the Dragon Kingdom improve its national defense strength. Of course, the premise is that the Dragon Kingdom must agree to some of our conditions."
Chapter 25 Eagle Country Mecha Exhibition, Technological Deterrence
Long Xingbu stood on the high platform and looked at the flattened hills, his eyes filled with shock. He originally thought that the Five Kingdoms were just bluffing, but now he knew that they were really capable of destroying the Dragon Kingdom. In his heart, he became more determined on the idea of ​​peace talks.
"Okay, okay, your country's technology is indeed well-deserved." Long Xingbu said quickly. "We can talk about cooperation slowly. As long as peace can be achieved, everything is easy to discuss."
When the envoy from Eagle Kingdom heard this, a satisfied smile appeared on his face. He knew that Long Xingbu had been shocked by the power of the mecha, and the peace talks were already a certainty.
The seven-member team stood in the crowd, their faces looking very ugly. "It's too arrogant. It's just a few broken iron bumps. What's the big deal?" Wukong said angrily. "If I get close to it, I can smash it with one stick."
"It's not that simple." Yang Jian shook his head. "These mechas have very strong defenses and fierce firepower. We can't get close at all. Even monks in the foundation-building stage can hardly resist missile attacks."
Zhuang Zhou looked at the mecha wreckage in the distance, his eyes full of fear. He recalled the scene in his nightmare, in which the Allied Forces of the Five Nations drove these mechas and launched a crazy massacre against the Dragon Kingdom. Countless people from the Dragon Kingdom died under the gunfire of the mechas, with rivers of blood and corpses strewn across the fields.
"It turns out that this is their confidence." Zhuang Zhou murmured to himself. "No wonder they dare to plan a conspiracy to destroy the country so blatantly. With these mechas, they don't take the martial arts of the Dragon Kingdom at all."
Xiaodie held Zhuang Zhou's hand tightly, her body trembling slightly. "Zhuang Zhou, these iron bumps are so scary. Will something happen to us?"
Zhuang Zhou took a deep breath, suppressed the fear in his heart, and comforted him softly. "Don't be afraid, nothing will happen. We will definitely find a way."
But his heart felt cold. He knew that the strength of a seven-man team alone would not be able to fight against the technological armies of the five countries. It would be as difficult as climbing to the sky to prevent this disaster.
After the mecha exhibition, the voices of the Lord and the faction became even louder. The ministers wrote to Long Xingbu one after another, requesting to sign a peace covenant with the five countries as soon as possible and not to provoke another war. Long Xingbu also made up his mind that no matter what conditions the five countries put forward, he would agree as long as peace can be obtained.
After Yuan Tiangang learned the news, he was very anxious and asked to see Long Xingbu again, but he was still turned away. He stood at the entrance of the palace, looking at the sky, crying. "Heaven wants to destroy our Dragon Kingdom, God wants to destroy our Dragon Kingdom."
